dataFolder.appLogsDesc: View detailed logs of the App.

shortcuts.globalShortcutActiveDesc: Press this shortcut anywhere to open the overlay and start recording.
shortcuts.globalShortcutInactiveDesc: The saved shortcut is not registered by the desktop.
shortcuts.globalShortcutResidentDisabledDesc: The shortcut will become active when keeping BiBit running is enabled.

interface.title: Interface
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Automatically summarize new conversations into a thread title. Turn off to keep the default title until you rename it yourself.

general.residentModeDesc: Keep the tray, quick chat, and voice entry points available after closing the main window. Turning this off also disables launch at login and exits BiBit.
general.autostartDesc: Start BiBit resident entry points in the background after desktop login.
general.popupGeometryDesc: Set the quick chat window width and height (300×400–600×800) in logical pixels.
general.popupGeometryError: Quick chat window was not changed
general.voiceServiceReady: Voice service is running; wake word and recognition are ready.
general.voiceServiceOffline: Voice service is not connected; voice input is unavailable.
general.voiceModelLoading: Loading voice models; they will be ready shortly.
general.voiceAsrDisabled: Speech recognition is off; turn it on to use voice input.
general.voiceMicUnavailable: Microphone is not ready; check the audio device.
general.wakeSwitchDesc: Wake voice input with the wake phrase; manual voice input still works when off.
general.asrSwitchDesc: Convert voice input into text; voice input is unavailable when off.
general.asrModelDesc: Choose the speech recognition model; switching runs in the background and the current engine stays active until it finishes.
general.voiceSwitching: Switching to {{model}}… (recognition is unavailable until it finishes)
general.voiceSwitchPersistWarning: The switches were applied, but saving the preference failed; they may revert after a restart.
general.voiceAudioOpenFailed: Microphone capture failed to start; voice input is unavailable.
general.voiceSwitchFailed: Engine switch failed: {{reason}}. {{model}} is still active.
general.voiceSwitchFilesMissing: The target engine is missing model files; nothing was switched.
general.voiceSwitchPersistFailed: Engine switched, but the preference could not be saved; a restart may fall back.
general.voiceSwitchInitFailed: Speech recognition failed to start and stays off.
general.voiceSwitchTimeout: The switch was not confirmed in time; retry or check the voice service.

attachments.enableDesc: Allow uploading and indexing documents for retrieval.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Choose how parsed documents are added to conversations.
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Fraction of the model context used as the cutoff for inlining parsed files on local models.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Maximum size per file. Enforced at upload and processing time.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Minimum similarity score (0-1). Only used for linear cosine search, not ANN.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Choose between sqlite-vec ANN, linear cosine, or auto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Approximate max characters per chunk for embeddings.

pluginAction.deactivateDescription: {{plugin}} will stop loading. Its files and grants are kept, so you can activate it again at any time.
pluginAction.uninstallDescription: This deletes the plugin files and grants of {{plugin}}, and cannot be undone. Reinstalling Bibit will not bring it back — you have to install the plugin bundle again manually.

modelUpdateFailed: Failed to update model. Please try again.
modelNameHint: This is the name that will be shown in the interface. The original model file remains unchanged.
tokenAlreadyConfigured: A token is already configured. Generate a new one to replace it.
